title: Python stdlib text trajectory delta skill
applies_when: candidate path is one of src/text_tools.py
starter function matches one of count_word_frequencies, extract_hashtags, normalize_whitespace, slugify_text, strip_markdown_links
avoid_when: do not activate until regressions are repaired: py_v1_extract_hashtags

evidence.public_prompt: Implement src/text_tools.py with count_word_frequencies(text). Return a dict mapping lowercase words to counts. Words are contiguous letters or digits. Ignore punctuation. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/text_tools.py with extract_hashtags(text). Return lowercase hashtag names from text in first-seen order. A hashtag starts with # and then has one or more letters, digits, or underscores. Do not include the # symbol. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/text_tools.py with normalize_whitespace(text). Collapse all whitespace runs in text to single spaces, trim leading/trailing whitespace, and return the normalized string. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/text_tools.py with slugify_text(text). Convert text to a URL slug: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric words, separated by single hyphens. Treat any non-alphanumeric run as a separator and strip separators at the ends. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.

Implement src/text_tools.py with strip_markdown_links(text). Replace Markdown inline links like [label](url) with just label. Leave other text unchanged. Use only the Python standard library. Do not include tests or extra files.
